messages:
incident-bot: P0 ALERT — routing fallback loop detected for customer 'AcmeDocs'. High 5xx rate on embeddings endpoint; traces show requests falling back to chat.variant-v2 (incompatible interface) causing schema errors and downstream 502s. https://redwood.ops/alerts/INC-8742 :rotating_light:
alex_sre: ack, paging @eric_oncall — are you available? this looks like a pinned-release -> alias mapping issue
eric_oncall: oncall here, taking it. starting root cause triage. opening thread.
mara_ml: saw this in model-router logs — anchor for alias acme-embeds is pinned to release-2024-11 which maps to chat.variant-v2 in eu-west. That variant doesn't implement embed interface -> fallback loop to gen path and 502s.
rita_support: customer 'AcmeDocs' reports ~40% of embedding requests failing since 10:12 UTC, several tickets opened (TKT-4829, TKT-4830). patch notes say they were using dedicated aliasacme-embed.
alex_sre: immediate mitigation: can we unpin alias or force-routing to compatible instruct-embed variant? which is quicker?
finn_infra: quickest is unpin the alias at control plane to allow smart routing to pick compatible variant. running: `curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/alias/unpin -d '{"alias":"acme-embed"}'`
eric_oncall: do it, and add fallback policy to prefer embed-capable variants. I'll monitor.
finn_infra: done — unpin API returned 200. patch: `alias acme-embed now unpinned (operator:finn_infra)`
mara_ml: pushing a temporary routing policy: prefer model family embed-* with compatibility check for endpoints. Command: `rbctl route update --alias acme-embed --policy 'compat:embedding,prefer:embed-*'`
eric_oncall: policy applied. watch metrics.
incident-bot: alert update — 5xx rate for acme-embed fell from 42% -> 8% over 3m. Error types: previously "schema_mismatch: chat_response" now mostly transient timeouts.
rita_support: update sent to customer: "We identified a mis-pinned release causing embedding requests to route to an incompatible chat variant. We've unpinned the alias and applied a compatibility-first policy. We're monitoring and will follow up with RCA."
carol_pm: need timeline and impact for postmortem. what's window and affected customers?
eric_oncall: impacted window: 10:12 — 10:18 UTC (mitigated at 10:15 by unpin, residual errors until 10:18). Primary affected: AcmeDocs (dedicated alias). Estimated ~12k requests, 5k failed.
mara_ml: root cause: deploy pipeline accidentally anchored alias acme-embed to release-2024-11 which contains chat.variant-v2 as the anchor model for eu-west due to a curation bug. The model catalog allowed cross-interface anchors.
alex_sre: next steps: 1) block cross-interface anchors in catalog validation 2) add a canary check for alias-pin changes 3) write an automatic unpin fallback when schema mismatch > threshold
finn_infra: created GH issue #INFRA-1297 for automatic unpin logic and #CATALOG-441 for validation.
eric_oncall: assigning oncall blameless postmortem. I'll handoff to mara_ml for root cause writeup.
rita_support: customer follow-up scheduled — offering credits for the window, prepping timeline.
carol_pm: thanks team. keep this thread for the RCA notes, we'll link in the all-hands brief. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — routing stabilized, metrics within SLO. Closing alert.
